purpose: One Light Cinema design suite across desktop, mobile and TV; six key pages per board, not competing style options.

desktop.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a meticulous high-fidelity UI DESIGN REVIEW BOARD, not a running website, for KatelyaTV. This is the DESKTOP member of ONE approved coherent design system named Light Cinema. The attached old desktop and mobile boards are product/context references ONLY: retain the video library purpose, familiar Chinese content and blue brand continuity; replace their glossy borders, crowded toolbars, gradients and giant hero with a quieter, much more usable layout. Do not reproduce fake capabilities from the old board.

Target: a 3840 x 2400 landscape design board, ultra sharp Chinese typography. Six complete 1440 x 900 logical desktop screens arranged three columns by two rows, proportionally scaled, with generous neutral canvas gutters. Header above board: "KatelyaTV / 轻量影院" and "电脑端 · 关键页面". Each frame has a small OUTSIDE caption: 首页 / 搜索 / 播放 / 历史 / 收藏 / 设置. No monitor hardware, browser chrome or perspective. Every screen must be readable and look like the same application. Board background warm off-white #EAECEB; app background #101216; subtle solid surfaces #191D24; dividers #2B313B; primary text #F1F3F5, secondary #A8B1C0; accent #78AAFF with near-black text on filled buttons; status green #5FD6A0 and amber #F3C779. Sparse rounded corners: cards 12px, buttons 8px. No glass, haze, neon, ambient gradients or drop shadow stacks. Use one system sans Chinese font, comfortable 16px body at logical size, muted labels never tiny.

Shared desktop shell: left 176px slim text sidebar, KatelyaTV brand at top; 首页 / 发现 / 收藏 / 历史; 设置 at bottom. Top unobtrusive persistent search with placeholder 搜索影片、剧集、综艺; at right 电视模式 and small account icon. Selected sidebar row uses a quiet tinted surface and blue left marker.

Screen 首页: top title 晚上好，接着看吧. Continue-watching FIRST with three LANDSCAPE still cards, progress bars, title and 第18集 · 已看24分钟, and a clear blue 继续播放 button on first card. Show visually rich cinematic photography on cards, Chinese drama 庆余年 第二季, 繁花, 三体. Next a compact 190px high featured strip with photo on right, title 漫长的季节 on left and 查看影片; not a giant billboard. Below one row of 5 portrait movie posters. Editorial clear hierarchy and breathing room.

Screen 搜索: search query 庆余年; obvious 普通搜索 / AI找片 tabs, 普通搜索 selected; type filter 全部 / 电影 / 剧集 / 综艺. Three visually distinct results grouped BY TITLE not by providers, each poster at left with year, type, episode count. Exact first title 庆余年 第二季, 2024 · 剧集 · 36集, and small 6个来源 label; second 庆余年 第一季. Clear primary 查看并播放, low emphasis 展开来源. No invented match percentage.

Screen 播放: wide cinematic player left (Chinese historical drama still) with working-looking pause, time 24:18 / 45:12, progress and fullscreen controls; right modest sidebar with 选集 / 线路 tabs. 选集 active with visible episodes 13–24, episode18 current blue; title 庆余年 第二季, subtitle 正在播放 第18集. Beside tabs small current-source text 当前：线路A; low emphasis 收藏. No downloads, comments, cast, payment or sharing features. Film image is lead, controls quiet.

Screen 历史: 播放历史 title, search-within-history, 管理 secondary action. Sections 今天 / 昨天, flat list of three thumbnail rows, title, episode and progress, blue 继续播放 only on focused/primary row; 删除 lower emphasis in 管理 state only. Quiet and spacious; avoid every row in a bordered card.

Screen 收藏: 我的收藏 title, 全部 / 电影 / 剧集 filters, clean 5-column portrait grid with titles and year below, no progress bars on unwatched items. One low emphasis 管理 button, no giant hero. Use distinct cinematic poster artwork consistent with rest.

Screen 设置: 设置 title, left internal category column 外观与设备 / 播放偏好 / 账号与数据. 外观与设备 selected. Right grouped rows: 外观 深色 / 浅色 / 跟随系统, 深色 selected; 电视模式 进入电视模式 action, clear text 适合遥控器操作. Below account section 当前账号 and 修改密码; low-emphasis red 退出登录 at bottom. No unexplained new settings. A small category 管理员设置 only as role-gated secondary link.

All exact Chinese text is UI text, not pasted paragraph commentary. Intentional whitespace, authentic usable video app. Do not include recommendations framed as unavailable features. Use same film stills and poster art across frames. Current date anchor 2026-10-19; relative 今天 / 昨天 only, no fabricated analytics.
